decision.rationale: The audited seed-42 development mean HR@10 is 0.590 for the candidate, 0.59475 for the incumbent, and 0.583 for the static-gate control. The candidate exceeds the control by 0.007 but falls below the incumbent by 0.00475 and misses the preregistered 0.59975 target. The supplied readout marks it ineligible for confirmation, so the selection is discard under the supplied rule. The development contrast does not establish a causal mechanism or a confirmation outcome.
unresolved_explanations: Independent initialization, optimization, or public-validation checkpoint selection could explain the candidate-control difference.
The static-gate control may be weaker than the incumbent; the candidate’s advantage over it does not establish useful content conditioning.
The candidate loses to the incumbent in three of four categories. Its contrasts with the control are near null in Movies_and_TV (+0.001) and CDs_and_Vinyl (-0.001).

No supplied direct test establishes trained gate sensitivity to content, initial block equivalence to the incumbent, or scoring identity after a nonzero update and save/load. Finite synthetic checks do not establish those diagnostics.
No independent-seed replication or confirmation result is supplied.
